expected.name: Netflix
expected.note: 44.900 COP x5 (Feb-Jun) then 49.900 x3 (Jul-Sep); +11% (more than the 10% cluster tolerance). Amounts stored x100 because the engine treats every currency as having 2 decimals.

expected.name: Smart Fit
expected.note: 99.900 COP; descriptor PAGO PSE SMART FIT

notes: No currency symbol or ISO code anywhere in the file (real Bancolombia exports are like this), so currency cannot be known from content; expected COP.
Amounts use '.' as thousands separator with no decimals (e.g. 1.250.000).
Debito/Credito are separate columns; Saldo is the running balance.
Rows 'COMPRA RAPPI*PEDIDO' (delivery orders, irregular) share the RAPPI brand with the Rappi Prime subscription.
A few dates are deliberately out of chronological order (2025-06-07, 2025-08-30) as real exports sometimes are.
